0022600164.text: Dallas hosts Sacramento in the Mavericks' seventh game of the season, with Dallas at 4-2 on a three-game winning streak, 2-1 at home, and 7th in the West, while the winless Kings are 0-6 after six straight losses and 15th in the West. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Kyrie Irving is day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), Zach LaVine is day-to-day with elbow soreness and a game-time decision, and the teams have not yet met this season, though in the last meeting on February 26, 2026, in Dallas, the Mavericks lost 130-121.
